answer: The applicant rents a numbered locker under one named river bridge for 48 hours and posts a 4,000 POA bond. A licensed metal forge stamps a wet violet wax seal onto a steel token bearing that locker number and one pubkey hash. The clerk photographs the wet seal under UV and posts the photo hash on a public board within 12 minutes; only then can the locker be claimed. Opening early, moving the token off-site, a dry or reapplied violet seal, or a second key on the same locker slashes the bond and retires it. Postal copies and screenshots fail: the UV wet-seal time must match the posted hash.
